summary: Round 2: still approved, zero critical. All four items you asked me to check specifically come back clean. Wave conflicts after the file moves: no file is modified by two tasks in the same wave — Wave 1 splits `internal/query/autovacuum_scores*.go` (T1) from `tables|indexes*.go` (T2); Wave 3 splits `top/*` (T4) from `report/describe.go`, `report/report_test.go`, `record/record.go` (T5); Waves 2, 4, 5 hold one task each. The `record` package specifically: Task 3 (Wave 2) modifies `record/record_test.go` and `record/recorder_test.go`, Task 5 (Wave 3) modifies `record/record.go` — disjoint files and different waves, so the move is safe on both axes. `top/config_view.go` is touched by T4 (Wave 3) and T6 (Wave 4) — sequential, not parallel. No dependency runs backwards against wave order and no cycle exists. Decisions 1, 6 and 8 grew but stayed decision-level: the additions are evidence (index arithmetic, the two-row cycle table, the owner's refusal), not implementation steps. No task description drifted back to HOW: no line numbers, no AC or TDD-anchor blocks, all descriptions at or under four sentences, and Task 1's rewrite to cite Decisions 2/3/4 is the shape the others should follow. All six required fields are present on Tasks 1-7; Task 8 correctly uses the template's reduced Pre-deploy QA form (Description, Skill, Reviewers only). Both round-1 majors are properly closed: row 7 now matches Task 7's grep-based Verify, `make lint`/`make vuln` are explicitly owned by Task 8, and `architecture.md` has an owner. Template compliance is otherwise unchanged from round 1 — frontmatter valid, every section present and filled, 8 decisions with Decision/Rationale/Alternatives, Risks table specific with a mitigation per row, no time-based estimates anywhere, 8 tasks across 5 waves plus Final Wave, all skills and reviewers in the catalog. Two majors remain, both consequences of edits that were not propagated: the rewritten Decision 8 now flatly contradicts the Acceptance Criteria and the Risks table on whether tech debt [020] gets amended, and the Per-task verification table still credits Task 5 with the recorder-trap fix that moved to Task 3.
